title: The Mask Hung Up for Good

collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen stands in front of the mud hut holding a small mask that belonged to someone they lost.

description_variants.description: An Isolan stands in front of the mud hut holding a small mask that belonged to someone they lost.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has carried a second mask for as long as anyone at the camp can remember: a small one, worn smooth, too small for (his/her) own face. It belonged to someone (he/she) lost a long time ago. Today (name1) stands in front of the mud hut holding it, and seems to be deciding something.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) ties the little mask to the doorpost of the mud hut, where everyone who passes will see it. Some of the children stop and look at it. A few touch it, gently, the way they have been taught. (name1) walks a little lighter after that, though (he/she) still stops by the doorpost most days.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) turns the mask over in (his/her) hands, then tucks it back where it always lives. Not yet. Maybe not ever. That is (his/her) choice to make, and nobody at the camp would dream of making it for (him/her). \(no effect\)
